sentences.text:
Rejaul Sk & Ors vs Unknown on 18 September, 2023
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh

Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
18.09.2023 In The High Court At Calcutta Item No.11 Criminal Revisional
Jurisdiction Ct.No.34 dc.
C.R.R. 3488 of 2023 In the matter of : Rejaul Sk & Ors. ... Petitioners.

Mr. Kingsuk Mondal ... For
the Petitioners.
Mr. Tanmay Kumar Ghosh, Ms. Sujata Das ...
For the State.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioners is directed to serve copy of this revisional application upon Ms. Sujata Das, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears for the State.
Her appointment may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

The petitioners are also directed to serve copy of this revisional application upon the opposite party no.2 by Speed Post with acknowledgement due and file affidavit-of-service on the next date fixed for hearing.

Learned advocate for the petitioners submits that initially Berhampore Police Station Case No. 1238 o f 2 0 2 2 d a t e d 1 9 . 0 9 . 2 0 2 2 w a s r e g i s t e r e d f o r i n v e s t i g a t i o n u n d e r S e c t i o n s 498A/325/307/376/379/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code by the complainant viz. Sujata Bibi.

Another case being Berhampore Women Police Station Case No. 141 of 2022 dated 24.11.2022 was registered for investigation under Sections 498A/448/195A/323/379/307/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 25/27 of Arms Act by the said Sujata Bibi subsequently.

entities.text: Berhampore Women Police Station Case No. 141 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the meantime, there was a decree for divorce.
Be that as it may within a short span of two months, two cases under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code were initiated at the instance of the same complainant Sujata Bibi.
Consequently the revisional application is required to be heard out on merits.
List the revisional application under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of January 2024.
Learned advocate for the State would produce the case diary of both the said cases.

Pending hearing of this revisional application, further proceedings relating to Berhampore Women Police Station Case No. 141 of 2022 dated 24.11.2022 pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Murshidabad at Berhampore be stayed till 31.01.2024.
